title: Media Overlay Card
description: The card every grid archive on the live site uses — tours, accommodation, destinations and brands all render it. A full-bleed image at least 368px tall, a warm-dark scrim across the whole of it, and the title centred on top in base with a chevron after it. The interaction is the distinctive part: the scrim *lifts* on hover, going fully transparent over half a second so the photograph comes forward rather than dimming. Measured from `.lsx-to-archive-template-grid … .lsx-to-archive-wrapper`, whose scrim is rgba(26, 18, 5, 0.3). The resting scrim is carried at 45% rather than that 30% so the title holds against a bright photograph. Structure lives here; the scrim colour, the hover lift, the chevron and the reduced-motion fallback live in assets/styles/core-group.css, because the css field strips :hover and drops any rule containing content:"".

styles.css: & { position: relative; overflow: hidden; } & .media-overlay-card__scrim { position: absolute; inset: 0; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; }
